Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Ajay - 42 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Riya - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Sharda - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Sharda stand near him.]

Vihaan: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan dances to the music.]

Anita (happily): "I knew it!"

[Vihaan thinks for a moment.]

Vihaan: "That's great!"

[Vihaan shouts angrily.]

Anita: "That's great!"

[Vihaan gives Mother a flower.]

Vihaan: "I'm ready!"

[Vihaan takes the bag from Mother.]

Sharda: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vihaan is sitting on a chair in the living room. Anita, Ajay and Riya stand near him.]

Vihaan: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan stands up.]

Anita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
